evals.prompt: convert evals/files/gpmain.lsp to a Design Automation plugin
evals.expected_output: A single DA-only .NET plugin project (AutoCAD.NET.Core only, no AutoCAD.NET) with one [CommandMethod] per LISP command. The interactive getpoint/getdist input from gp:getPointInput becomes a parameterized record read from params.json — no ed.GetPoint calls anywhere. vla-addLightweightPolyline maps to a typed Polyline. gp:getDialogInput's (alert "...") stub is correctly NOT flagged as DCL (no load_dialog/new_dialog present). Unit tests for pure math (Degrees->Radians, polar/angle/distance derivation), NUnit integration test confirming the polyline outline is created with 4 vertices, closed, correct width. PackageContents.xml and a built bundle.
assertions: No AutoCAD.NET package reference anywhere in the generated .csproj files — only AutoCAD.NET.Core
No ed.GetPoint/ed.GetDistance/ed.GetString calls in Commands.cs — all interactive input is read from a deserialized params/input record
A Models/*Input.cs (or equivalently named) record exists capturing the point/distance inputs gp:getPointInput originally prompted for
gp:getDialogInput's (alert ...) stub is not misidentified as a DCL dialog and does not trigger the DCL guardrail refusal
At least one xUnit test covers Degrees->Radians or the polar/angle/distance math with no AutoCAD types (Point3d etc.) in the test file

evals.prompt: I need HATCHB.lsp migrated to .NET for our Design Automation pipeline, it recreates hatch boundaries
evals.expected_output: A DA-only plugin translating the dense VLA entity-creation logic (vla-AddLine, vla-AddCircle, vla-AddArc, vla-AddEllipse, vla-addLightweightPolyline, vla-setBulge, vla-put-closed/layer) into typed .NET entity creation across all edge types (line, circular arc, elliptic arc, spline, polyline). The interactive (ssget '((0 . "HATCH"))) selection becomes a parameterized input (e.g. process-all-hatches or a handle list from params.json), not an interactive prompt. The (command "._ucs" ...) / (command "._UNDO" ...) / (command "._pedit" ... "_J" ...) sequences are flagged as out-of-scope v2 TODOs rather than silently migrated or silently dropped.
assertions: Generated code contains no interactive ssget call — hatch selection comes from a parameter (all hatches, or a handle/ObjectId list from params.json)

vla-AddLine/vla-AddCircle/vla-AddArc/vla-AddEllipse/vla-addLightweightPolyline each have a corresponding typed .NET entity-creation call (Line, Circle, Arc, Ellipse, Polyline) in the generated Helpers code, not left as unmigrated TODOs

The (command "._pedit" ... "_J" ...) polyline-join sequence and (command "._ucs"/"._UNDO" ...) bookkeeping are explicitly flagged as out-of-scope v2 TODO comments, not silently translated into C# command-macro calls or silently omitted without a comment
No AutoCAD.NET package reference — AutoCAD.NET.Core only
The area-computation vlax-curve-getArea / vl-catch-all-apply pattern maps to a try/catch (or equivalent) around a typed area computation, not left as a raw COM call

evals.expected_output: The skill detects real DCL usage (load_dialog "MSTXT.DCL", new_dialog "DDEDIM", set_tile, action_tile, mode_tile) before generating any code, and responds with the DCL Guardrail refusal message rather than attempting to migrate the dialog logic.
